subject: english
question: Identify the most suitable title for the passage.

options.text: One Good Turn from the Aviation Industry

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage discusses the efforts of major airlines to reach **net-zero carbon emissions**, which includes the use of sustainable aviation fuels and investments in related start-ups.
 
• **It highlights the initiatives and experimental use of sustainable fuels by airlines like United Airlines, reflecting a positive and proactive approach of the aviation industry towards addressing climate change.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
 
• **Success Story of Airline Companies:** The passage is focused on future plans and initiatives rather than past successes.
 
• **Threats of Climate Changes:** While climate change is the backdrop for the initiatives, the passage is more about the proactive steps being taken rather than the threats themselves.
 
• **Biofuels Vs Synthetic Fuels:** Though both types of fuels are mentioned, the passage does not compare them explicitly; it is more about the overall initiative towards sustainability.
